summary: Derives the servant research proposal extraction schema directly from canonical ResearchPlanCreateRequest DTO rather than maintaining a divergent handwritten schema that permitted arbitrary nested properties under stages while the strict DTO forbade them. Projections into the OpenClaw adapter subset resolve local acyclic $defs references, project nullable anyOf unions into type: [T, null], remove default annotations without dropping validation keywords, enforce additionalProperties: false on stage items, and preserve domain enums for spec_version ('1.0') and stage_type (ALLOWLISTED_STAGE_BACKENDS). Fails closed on cyclic or unknown refs, unsupported general unions, and preserves unsupported constraint keywords for fail-closed adapter validation. Extends tests to verify against actual canonical DTO and actual adapter validator on the three-extra-field counterexample (model, universe, quantity1) and complete valid drafts with routing, dependencies, budget, execution constraints, and nullables. Preserves true PR 6592 head f720d171a Claude approval history (2026-10-16T03:11:32Z) and subsequent Smoke 38843988289/job 116790881136 CI failure (2026-10-16T03:15:33Z: test_bff_test_architecture.py::test_migrated_suites_do_not_mutate_sys_path, 1FAIL/38PASS on sys.path.insert at line 25).
